source_contract: Root-selected frozen candidate mlp.rs full-file byte-identical prefix; wrapper calls actual prepare_ffn_fp8_split and project_up_and_gate. No performance claim.
prior_reuse: m03-producer-local-ffn/validation v2 root device entry and cases0..5 F64 oracle
comparison: BF16 bitwise except signed zero equivalence; all nonfinite output rejected; NaN initialized destination

input_boundary_scope.scale: Different up/gate block scales in cases0/1/3/6/7; per-six-row and cluster changes in6/7; runtime x_scale from actual quantizer

numerical_limit: The eight finite dyadic inputs are targeted cases, not general BF16 or full-model equivalence. Existing native three-term approximation remains. Final/block F32 exactness assertions alone do not prove every alternate intermediate order exact.
scope_exclusions: down/GeGLU/RMS not changed here; tested separately by whole FFN
diagnostic timings excluded from performance comparison
decision_policy: No tuning/adoption threshold in probe. Any failure preserves evidence and requires a specific supported repair or diagnosis; root owns overall performance/adoption decision.
